newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China EB-IHD in asset injection talks.
newsitem.headline: China EB-IHD in asset injection talks.

text.p: China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd said it is in talks on possible acquisitions, including stakes in National Mutual Asia Ltd and International Bank of Asia Ltd (IBA), from its controlling shareholder China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd.
Equity interests in National Mutual and IBA owned by its controlling shareholder were among the proposed acquisitions being negotiated, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
China Everbright Holdings has attributable interest of about 2.5 percent in National Mutual and 20 percent in IBA, it said.
"However, no terms have been finalised and no binding agreement has been entered into yet," the company said.
China Everbright-IHD raised HK$324 million earlier this year by issuing 132.99 million shares to its controlling shareholder.

The company had said the money would be used to expand the company's investment portfolio, including possible asset acquisitions from China Everbright Holdings. But China Everbright-IHD denied newspaper reports it was planning a reorganisation and was setting up a life insurance joint venture company with the National Mutual group in China.
As far as the directors were presently aware, no such plans have been formulated or implemented, it added.
